recommendedEntrypoints.name: local-wrapper
recommendedEntrypoints.useWhen: This repository includes the Lattice bootstrap wrapper.

recommendedEntrypoints.name: global-fallback
recommendedEntrypoints.useWhen: Only the global lattice CLI is available for read-only heartbeats; do not use it as current-worktree gate/status evidence when a local wrapper or core CLI exists.

notes: This file is read by Lattice tooling, not by the Codex runtime.
Codex agent prompts live in .lattice-codex/agents and are generated from .claude/agents in full asset mode.
Codex native hooks are official lowercase .codex assets and live in a separate directory from .lattice-codex.
Claude Code hooks, settings, and skills remain under .claude only.
Run node bin/lattice-codex.js verify_codex after changing Codex adapter assets; it records codex_adapter_verification evidence for gates.
Legacy project documents may remain archived, but active Codex adapter assets use .lattice-codex/lattice.json and bin/lattice-codex.js.
